shared_elements: horizontal rows or bands of repeated signs/geometric motifs
justification: The main correspondence is that both surfaces appear to combine schematic figural imagery with rows of repeated sign-like or geometric motifs, possibly including an upright anthropomorphic/zoomorphic figure. The biggest difference is that A has clearly organized registers with multiple profile animals/birds and dense patterned bands, while B seems dominated by a single faint central figure with different flanking/bottom signs and no matching specific iconographic scheme.
